target_customer: Insurance-covered primary-care patients and partner clinics seeking preventive longevity care
problem: Preventive, lifestyle-driven care between visits is not reimbursed or continuous; Mederva builds personalized longevity protocols with coaches and bills insurance. At founding it connected doctors in developing countries with US medical experts.
business_model: Clinic partnerships and insurance-reimbursed care programs (per YC page and company site); earlier telemedicine expert-consult platform

outcome_analysis: Mederva is Active per YC, a 13-person San Francisco company that moved from a developing-world telemedicine expert network to insurance-covered longevity care. No funding beyond YC's investment, no exit and no layoffs were found, so there is no sourced outcome yet; the stage and traction are unknown.
